arms.U: same corrupted language graph, updated only from public first-hit evidence during acquisition
arms.D: all directed edges independently Beta(1,1), no directed/language information, same updater and schedule as U

pairing: within controller/world/stream, arms receive identical target-uniform and action-uniform arrays
graph_privacy: graph and correction/update flags remain inside TargetProvider; policy receives only target_onehot5, normalized_target_age, and v10 observable inputs
update: on each public first hit t, earlier first-hit s adds s->t positive and t->s counterevidence; pending evidence is applied at each 1000-action target-window boundary or terminal; graph persists across acquisition worlds within controller/stream; target is reselected after hit, window boundary, or terminal; GRU hidden is retained and target age resets
freeze: U/D graphs freeze after the 40th acquisition world; evaluation performs no graph update and no optimizer step
target_recovery: TV is averaged over the same fixed 31 non-complete achieved masks at age zero, querying O/F/U counterfactually in identical contexts; it is not rollout marginal target frequency
